Name: Bald Hair Mod
Author: ShamanKem
Description:
I made the first Hairstyle invisible.
I had to change the Farmer Sprites and adjust the other Hairsytyles to fit the new Occiput.

Installation:
Copy the XNB files into
"Gamefolder"\Content\Characters\Farmer\
Backup the original Files

Everybody is free to use this mod for his mods/compilations.
But be aware that i edited the Farmersprites too, I had to make the back of the head bigger that can cause some bugs with other hairstyles.
